notes: Investigated via direct HTTP fetch (bot-check bypassed with a standard browser User-Agent; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, only User-agent:* and a Pinterest crawl-delay). Checked: (1) full site navigation/mega-menu extracted from the homepage's embedded nav JSON, 373 unique nav labels covering Furniture, Decor and accessories, Bathroom, Kids, Outdoor, plus all country/language switchers - zero Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year/festive/holiday/seasonal terms present. (2) category-sitemap.xml (all locale variants) and the live Algolia categories_list facet (42 real category values, e.g. Sofas, Decor and accessories, Lighting, Bathroom) - no holiday-named category exists live; a 'Christmas Decoration' label exists only inside the platform's internal i18n label dictionary with 0 live products and no reachable URL (probed /o/decor-and-accessories/christmas-decoration, /o/christmas-decoration, /c/christmas-decoration, /o/decor-and-accessories/christmas - all 404). (3) collection-sitemap.xml - no holiday-named collections. (4) selection-sitemap.xml - found 8 thinly-populated marketing 'Selections' pages with Christmas/Valentine's wording in their slugs (christmas 1, christmas-gifts 77, festive-decoration 72, prepare-the-christmas-table 56, christmas-market 18, when-christmas-returns 135, a-personal-christmas 1, valentines-day-chill-relax 1 - counts confirmed live via direct Algolia product-index queries on the site's own public search key). Inspected the actual product contents of every one of these pages (15-25 sampled titles each): all are ordinary furniture/decor/tableware/rugs/lamps (sofas, coffee tables, rugs, candles, glassware, vases) with no Christmas- or Valentine-specific products (no ornaments, trees, wreaths, stockings, Advent items). These are seasonal gift-guide/entertaining-guide marketing landing pages built from the regular catalog, not genuine holiday-specific product categories, so they were excluded under the shared Gift Guide / marketing-page exclusion and the seasonal-theme-vs-seasonal-category rule. Kave Home currently has no genuine seasonal/holiday product-listing category.
